notes: UK kitchenware specialist on Shopify (site title 'Cookware, Bakeware, Cleaning & Laundry'); narrow decor footprint as expected. Access: direct fetch worked throughout (HTTP 200, no WAF). Count method: Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json enumeration (paged, deduped by id), confirmed exact by cross-checking dedicated collection URLs against product_type facet counts inside the broader 'tableware' (660 products) and 'homeware' (602 products) collections -- counts matched exactly in every case, so the per-collection products.json total is treated as ground truth before manual title-level filtering. Exclusions applied per scope: kitchen appliances/cookware/cutlery/bar tools (Cutlery Sets, Cafetieres & Coffee Pots, Fondue & Raclette Sets, Tea Strainers all fully excluded as functional kitchen equipment); textiles (Napkins, Tablecloths & Table Runners, Tea Cosies, Place Mats & Coasters, Tea Towels, Door Mats, Door Runners, Draught Excluders, Aprons); Home Fragrance (own 23-item collection, plus a 65-item 'Candles' collection titled 'Candle & Tealight Holders | Partyware' that is dominated by scented (Stoneglow/Wax Lyrical/citronella) and Christmas-themed (Advent/Santa/tree/poinsettia) SKUs -- excluded in full as a Partyware/Holiday+Fragrance roll-up, distinct from the clean, unscented, non-holiday 'LED Candles' (7) and 'Candle Holders' (13) collections which were kept); Holiday & Gift (individual Christmas/Advent/Santa/Nutcracker/festive SKUs dropped title-by-title out of otherwise in-scope buckets -- see per-row evidence); Fireplace Accessories (32, mostly kindling tools/covers, not a decor taxonomy category); non-decor Homeware SKUs (Oven Gloves, Cook Books, Shopping Bags & Trolleys, Diaries, Furniture Pads, Steps & Stools, Door Stops, Pot Holders). Mixed-rollup handling: the 'Mirrors' collection (32) and several 'tableware' product_type buckets (Bowls, Serving Boards & Dishes, Gravy Boats, Butter Dishes, Cheese Boards) were verified product-by-product via the full products.json title dump and manually filtered per 'drop, don't pad' -- see each row's evidence for the exact drop list. Rule 0: kept all genuine mirror-type products (illuminated/magnifying/sensor/shower/travel/cosmetics mirrors) despite personal-care/bathroom framing, per 'ALL mirrors are in scope'; excluded only the clearly non-mirror items mistagged into that same product_type bucket (face masks, SAD light therapy lamps, a jewellery case, a hairdryer-holder, a bulb, an eye mask). False-absence checks: confirmed via direct collection-URL probing (all 404) and cross-checked with on-site search that Lakeland carries no dedicated Vases, Wall Art, Clocks, Planters, Sculptures, Figurines, Photo Frames, Candlesticks (standalone), Table/Floor/Pendant/Ceiling/Wall Lamps, or Lampshades lines -- consistent with its narrow kitchenware-specialist positioning; these categories are therefore omitted rather than null-flagged. Duplicate-company determination: no other Lakeland entry found in this project's completed batch; Lakeland (lakeland.co.uk) is a distinct UK-only kitchenware retailer, not a duplicate of any other S.N. processed so far.
